description: Japan Municipality Statistics. Official statistics for every municipality in Japan in one JSON API, for real-estate tools, relocation apps, local-business dashboards and AI agents. Routes: /rank (indicator*, year, prefecture, order, limit, offset); /indicators; /municipalities (q, prefecture, limit, offset); /municipalities/{code} (indicator). Paid $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /rank, /indicators, /municipalities, /municipalities/{code}. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
